ECE 685 | Power Systems Design L12
Transformer Modeling III
Determining model parameters from transformer tests
Buxin She
Mike Wiegers Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

Lecture outline
1 Part 1: Use the open-circuit (OC) test to determine excitation parameters
2 Part 2: Use the short-circuit (SC) test to determine series parameters
3 Part 3: Analyze voltage regulation and efficiency
L11 established the equivalent circuit. Today the OC and SC tests determine its
unknown parameters, which then predict loaded operation.
ECE 685 | Transformer Modeling III 2/39

Determining model parameters
STARTING PROBLEM
We know the equivalent circuit of a practical
transformer, but its parameter values are
unknown. How can we determine these
parameters experimentally?
